Once the agent finds the redstone_block, it can orient itself to locate and mine the nearby red_sandstone. This creates a natural dependency: the redstone_block acts as a visual guide that the agent must discover first before it can navigate to and mine the red_sandstone. Both tasks are observable and verifiable — finding the redstone_block is a visual/proximity check, and mining red_sandstone can be verified by checking inventory. Neither task requires deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, making them accessible.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to navigate near the target and visually observe it. The redstone_block pillar is at spawn-relative [6, 1, 7] (the upper block of the 2-high pillar, placed via /setblock ~6 ~1 ~7). max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to have clearly located the landmark, and facing_tolerance=45 ensures they are actually looking at it rather than passing by coincidentally.

Uses inventory_has because mining red_sandstone causes it to drop as a 'red_sandstone' item that enters the player's inventory. CommonSenseAgent confirmed red_sandstone drops itself without needing silk touch. The player has an iron pickaxe (given via /give) which is more than sufficient. Checking inventory for min_count=1 is the most direct and reliable way to verify the block was actually mined.

scene_description: A flat grass platform with a prominent 2-high redstone_block pillar serving as a landmark, flanked by stone blocks. Nearby (3 blocks away), a red_sandstone deposit (L-shaped, 9 ground blocks + 2 stacked) provides the mining target. The player spawns with an iron pickaxe and must first locate the redstone_block landmark, then navigate to the adjacent red_sandstone and mine it.
task_text: Find the bright red redstone_block landmark on the grass platform, then locate the nearby red_sandstone deposit (orange blocks) and mine at least one red_sandstone block using the iron pickaxe in your inventory.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at origin (0,0,0) on grass. Redstone_block pillar at (~6, 0-1, ~7) — 2 blocks tall for visibility. Red_sandstone deposit at (~9-11, 0-1, ~6-8) — L-shaped with 11 total blocks, 3 blocks east of the redstone landmark. Stone accent blocks at (~5, 0, ~6) and (~5, 0, ~8) frame the redstone pillar. The 25x25 grass platform provides a clear, flat arena. Air fill up to y+5 clears any trees. Iron pickaxe given to player for mining red_sandstone. The redstone_block is a 'find' task (proximity + facing check). The red_sandstone is the mining target (inventory check).
